$comment: Fixture allowlist for the F2-landed tree: the two permits still live after the renames. The repository's two F2 permits go stale on that tree and are deleted by a follow-up, so they are not repeated here.

allow.reason: F2 retired the zone name; the rename note still cites both forms, which are one letter apart.
Drakeld is the root dictionary's example compound for drak (stone), not an attested name or place, and D5 declined to block.
